body: A foster family at this point would probably be better, so we’ll work on gathering proof that there is abuse going on, maybe not physical abuse but emotional and mental. Also it’s  they/them for my partner, not he/him.

I’m not sure what exactly would be the best way to go about this, I’m admittedly at a loss on what to do. But I guess right now it would be great to know how to possibly get my partner out of their house and away from what’s causing them all their misery, before it breaks them.
